rec.name: PDP Color Variant Selector (Swatches / Product Images / Text Buttons)
rec.status: Backlog — not built (spec only; ticket reassigned and parked in backlog)

what.text: A custom Shopify section, "CRO | PDP | Farbvarianten" (Color Variants), that replaces the default color option picker on the product page. The merchant picks one of three display modes: (1) round or square color swatches, (2) product-image thumbnails per color, or (3) text buttons. Every mode shows the label with the active color name (e.g. "Color: khaki" or "Farbe: Washed black"), highlights the current selection, and updates image, price and availability when a color is chosen. The text-button mode shows unavailable variants struck through and disabled (e.g. "Denim"). The ticket allows building this as one section with a mode setting or as three separate sections.

why.text: Visual color pickers reduce effort and uncertainty: shoppers see the real product or true color instead of decoding a dropdown or text label. Image thumbnails show how each colorway looks on the product, which supports confident choices and encourages browsing other colors. Showing the active color name and a clear selected state gives constant feedback. Struck-through, disabled unavailable options prevent dead-end clicks and frustration. Together this lowers friction at the key variant-selection step.

how.text: Build one theme section (or three) with a display-mode select: swatches, images or text. Render the option values for the color option from the product variants. Swatches use a color value from a metafield or a mapping of color names to hex. Image mode uses the variant's featured image or a metafield, and the ticket says color values can be maintained via metafield or variant logic. On click, switch the variant, then update the main gallery image, price and availability via the variant-change event or section rendering. Mark unavailable variants as disabled with a strikethrough. Expose typography, color, bold, alignment, shape and order settings in the theme editor.

items: Display mode: color swatches / product images / text buttons
Active color label: font, text color, bold toggle, alignment (left, vertically centered)
Label text (e.g. "Color"/"Farbe") editable in text mode
Product-image mode: color values via metafield or variant logic
Text buttons: font, text color, bold, alignment
Text buttons: style from round to square, button color
Text buttons: selected state (border, frame or different color)
Unavailable variants shown struck through and disabled

dependencies.text: Products need a Color variant option. Swatch mode needs a color value per option (metafield or color-name-to-hex mapping), and image mode may need a metafield or variant images. Variant-change logic must update gallery image, price and availability. No app is mentioned. Assumes a theme with section/block settings and JS for variant switching.

items: Conversion rate on products with multiple colors

images.caption: Text-button mode: "Color" label, pill buttons, selected "Oyster" filled dark, unavailable "Denim" struck through and disabled.
Product-image mode: "Farbe: Washed black" in bold above image thumbnails per color, with the active one outlined in black.
Color swatch mode: "Farbe: khaki" label with round swatches, active swatch marked with an inner dot and a ring border.
